concept.title: Purpose
concept.shortdesc: This guide provides mandatory best practices for anyone who creates or prepares .docx source content

conbody.p: This guide provides mandatory best practices for anyone who creates or prepares .docx source content for conversion to DITA-XML using the metR DocMigration DOCX to DITA converter. The converter is a modular microservice with an embedded AI Agent, which reasons and enriches DITA elements over document structure before transforming it into standards-compliant DITA-XML.

ul.li: The converter correctly identifies topic boundaries, heading hierarchies, and content types.
The AI Conversion Agent classifies topics accurately as concept, task, reference, troubleshooting, or generic.
The generated DITA-XML output is clean, complete, and requires minimal post-conversion cleanup.
Metadata and DITA map hierarchies are detected reliably.
